items.q: Why does the timeline grow when I add add-ons?
items.a: Every three add-ons take roughly two more business days to build and test. The calculator adds them for you. The rush option cuts the timeline by 40%.

items.q: What if my option isn't listed?
items.a: Mention it in the comment. User accounts, complex logic or integrations with your own systems fall under the Custom package from €9,000, quoted after a call.
